t: A Tai kingdom founded around 1238 when local chiefs expelled the Khmer governor of Sukhothai.
Under Ram Khamhaeng in the late thirteenth century its overlordship stretched across much of present-day Thailand.
Ayutthaya made it a vassal in 1378 and absorbed it around 1438, but it became the founding kingdom of Thai history.
dyk: Ram Khamhaeng's inscription says a bell hung at the palace gate so that any subject with a grievance could ring it and be heard by the king.
ev: Bang Klang Hao expels the Khmer governor and becomes king as Si Inthrathit
Date of the Ram Khamhaeng inscription; embassies to the Yuan court begin about this time
Li Thai takes the throne and begins a Buddhist revival
Ayutthaya is founded in the lower Chao Phraya basin
Sukhothai submits as a vassal of Ayutthaya
Sukhothai is absorbed into Ayutthaya on the death of Maha Thammaracha IV

f.founder: Si Inthrathit (Pho Khun Bang Klang Hao)
